seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,target,wall] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w,y x1, pixels,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: walls 10 (H axis row + V axis col), targets 11 solid, pieces 5 holed, mirrors 4.
All three mirrors of every piece block (across V, across H, across both) are visible; clipped to board, skipped on piece cells.
Selection from 0 dots (wall dots off the intersection first, then piece 0 centres); A1-A4 move H/V axis along its own direction or the selected piece (blocked by edges/other pieces); A5 cycles H->V->pieces by min block->H.
HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective (model-changing) action; rule is stateless.
Hypothesis "reflection A3 mixed outcomes" = object re-extraction (mirror clipping/re-ranking), irrelevant to frames; piece-on-axis invisible mirror never observed.
